description: Consumer-side Renovate configuration. All policy lives in shared_workflow's modular presets, composed here at one exact tag -- there is deliberately no floating major.
No runner workflow is needed in this repository: shared_workflow runs Renovate centrally with autodiscover, and processes only repositories that commit a Renovate configuration.
base and github-actions are listed explicitly for readability; flutter already extends dart, which extends allowlist.
gradle is in scope because android/*.gradle.kts and android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties exist. CocoaPods is not: Flutter generates the Podfile at first iOS build.
